description: Mines the vanity salt, computes the start tick, simulates, and returns an UNSIGNED factory transaction plus the predicted token address. This server never signs or sends anything: the wallet owner signs and sends the returned transaction. There are no defaults for the fee or share settings: ask the owner for suffix, holderShareBps, burnShareBps, creatorBuyFeeBps and creatorSellFeeBps and show them the summary before signing. Creator fees are permanent.

burnShareBps.description: Share of the remaining creator fee that is burned. The creator can change this later.

chainId.description: 1 Ethereum, 56 BNB Chain, 8453 Base, 4663 Robinhood Chain, 57073 Ink

creator.description: The wallet that will send the transaction. It becomes the creator.

creatorBuyFeeBps.description: Creator fee on buys, 0 to 1000 (10%). Permanent.

creatorSellFeeBps.description: Creator fee on sells, 0 to 1000 (10%). Permanent.

firstBuy.description: Creator's own first buy in the native coin, e.g. 0.05. Omit for none.

holderShareBps.description: Share of the creator fee sent to holders. 3000 = 30%

quoteAsset.description: Approved quote asset address. Omit for the chain's native coin.

suffix.description: 3 to 5 hex characters the token address will end with. No default: ask the owner.
